16418               	; 	' AND THE TITLE'S DISPLAY LIST, for the same reason as the font: walked
16419               	; 	' once by title_draw, at boot and on a return to the title, and never
16420               	; 	' during play. title_draw selects bank 2 around its walk.
16421               	; 	'
16422               	; 	' ITS MESSAGE BOXES DID NOT COME WITH IT. They are the same format and
16423               	; 	' were in the same generated file, which is what made this worth doing
16424               	; 	' carefully: they are walked when a ROUND ENDS, mid-game, so on bank 2
16425               	; 	' they would have returned bytes from the wrong page at the moment a life
16426               	; 	' is lost -- and with no error at build or run time. gentitle.py now
16427               	; 	' writes them to title.bas below, which stays in bank 1.
16428               	; 	INCLUDE "titledl.bas"
16429               	; 	' ==================================================
16430               	; 	' THE TITLE SCREEN, AS A DISPLAY LIST
16431               	; 	' Generated by assets/gentitle.py -- do not edit here.
16432               	; 	'
16433               	; 	' row, col, length, then `length` bytes; 255 ends.
16434               	; 	' Walked by title_draw only.
16435               	; 	'
16436               	; 	' LIVES IN BANK 2, with the fonts, because it is read ONCE
16437               	; 	' -- at boot and on a return to the title. title_draw
16438               	; 	' selects bank 2 around its walk and restores bank 1.
16439               	; 	' The message boxes in title.bas are the same format and
16440               	; 	' CANNOT come with it: they are read when a round ends.
16441               	; 	' ==================================================
16442               	;

16636               	; 	INCLUDE "art.bas"
16637               	; 	' Keystone Kapers art -- GENERATED by assets/genart.py. Do not edit; regenerate.
16638               	; 	'
16639               	; 	' EVERY SPRITE IS 16x16: sprite size and magnification are GLOBAL on the
16640               	; 	' TMS9918, so small objects are drawn small INSIDE a 16x16 box rather than
16641               	; 	' being small sprites.
16642               	; 	'
16643               	; 	' EVERY 8-PX OBJECT SITS IN ROWS 8-15 OF ITS BOX, ducked Kelly included, so
16644               	; 	' one rule places them all: bottom edge = y + 16, and a thing resting on the
16645               	; 	' floor is at y = FLOORY - 16.
16646               	; 	'
16647               	; 	' Sprite bytes are QUADRANT-ORDERED: 16 rows of the left half, then 16 of
16648               	; 	' the right. Every block is an EVEN number of bytes -- an odd DATA BYTE run
16649               	; 	' silently misaligns every word table after it (CLAUDE.md 3A).
16650               	;
16651               	; spr_kelly:	' Kelly: RIGHT hat/face/the four merged run bodies/duck hat/face/body, then the same LEFT (+36). The run bodies carry tunic AND legs, so a frame is one sprite. Patterns 0..68

17892               	; 	INCLUDE "store.bas"
17893               	; 	' Keystone Kapers store -- GENERATED by assets/genstore.py. Do not edit.
17894               	; 	'
17895               	; 	' EIGHT band templates of 5 rows x 32 cols (160 bytes each) plus a 32-byte
17896               	; 	' index over (level, screen). The whole 8-screen, 4-level building is about
17897               	; 	' 1.3 KB instead of the 5,120 bytes it would cost to store literally.
17898               	; 	'
17899               	; 	' All eight templates are ONE contiguous block under ONE label, so a band
17900               	; 	' blit is
17901               	; 	'     SCREEN stor_tpl, tpl*160, toprow*32, 32, 5, 32
17902               	; 	' with no label ladder -- SCREEN needs a literal label and a label cannot be
17903               	; 	' chosen by a variable, which is why RallyX needed a 4-way IF over its maze
17904               	; 	' tables. One block sidesteps it.
17905               	; 	'
17906               	; 	' 160 is EVEN, so this cannot leave the location counter odd and misalign
17907               	; 	' the word tables defined after it.
17908               	; 	'
17909               	; 	' template ids:
17910               	; 	'   0 T_AISLE_A
17911               	; 	'   1 T_AISLE_B
17912               	; 	'   2 T_ESC_W
17913               	; 	'   3 T_ESC_E
17914               	; 	'   4 T_ELEV
17915               	; 	'   5 T_ROOF0
17916               	; 	'   6 T_ROOF1
17917               	; 	'   7 T_ROOF2
17918               	; 	'   8 T_ROOF3
17919               	; 	'   9 T_ROOF4
17920               	; 	'   10 T_ROOF5
17921               	; 	'   11 T_ROOF6
17922               	; 	'   12 T_ROOF7
17923               	; 	'   13 T_END_W
17924               	; 	'   14 T_END_E
17925               	;
17926               	; stor_tpl:	' 15 templates x 160 bytes
